{{MangaPrevNext/Adventures |prevcode=PS332 |prevtitle=The Final Battle V |nextcode=PS334 |nexttitle=The Final Battle VII |series=Emerald |colorscheme=Emerald}} {{ChapInfobox |title_en=The Final Battle VI |subtitle=The True Eye |title_ja=大決戦VI |title_ro=The Final Battle VI |image=PS333.png |scheme=Emerald |pub1=Shogakukan full volume |pub1-data=Chapter 333 in {{vol|Pokémon Adventures|29}} |pub2=VIZ Media full volume |pub2-data=Adventure 333 in {{vol|Pokémon Adventures|29}} |location={{gdis|Battle Tower|III}} }} '''The Final Battle VI''' (Japanese: '''大決戦VI ''' ''The Final Battle VI ''), titled '''The Final Showdown VI''' in the [[Chuang Yi]] translation, is the 333rd chapter of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga, and the 31st chapter of the {{MangaArc|Emerald}}. It is subtitled '''The True Eye''' (Japanese: '''真実の瞳 ''' ''The Eye of Truth '') in the [[VIZ Media]] translation and '''The Eye of Truth''' in the Chuang Yi translation. ==Plot== {{spoilers}} Having bought time for them, {{adv|Gold}} asks if {{adv|Ruby}}, {{adv|Sapphire}}, and {{adv|Emerald}} have mastered the ultimate moves yet. [[Guile Hideout]], riding on top of his monster {{p|Kyogre}}, tells it to attack the {{gdis|Battle Frontier|III}} once again. The wave engulfs the Battle Frontier, causing it to begin sinking once more. Guile laughs at the power the monster Kyogre possesses. He notices Ruby, Sapphire, and Emerald trying to learn the ultimate moves while being protected by {{p|Mr. Mime}}'s solidified air room. He dares his opponents to face one that has become one with the sea. Angered at what he did to {{adv|Crystal}}, Emerald sends his other Pokémon to attack. Guile easily smacks them away with his sword, and begins stepping on Mr. Mime's head to taunt Emerald. Emerald tells Guile to stop it, but Guile notes that Emerald stated that he didn't like Pokémon, but Pokémon battling. Guile calls states that Pokémon that cannot battle are nothing more than useless garbage that should be trashed. He moves over to the statue of {{adv|Silver}}, stating that the same applies to humans as well. Guile asks Emerald if he agrees with what he said. Emerald tells Guile that he's wrong, and that he always wished that he had friends to have bonds with. Emerald reveals that it's not the Pokémon battles he likes, but the Pokémon themselves and those who like them. Suddenly, Emerald, Ruby, Sapphire, Gold, and Crystal's [[Pokédex]]es begin beeping. They assume the five Pokédexes are resonating with each other, but Sapphire notes that there are more sounds coming from elsewhere. As the statues begin chipping away, Sapphire reveals that there are actually ten locations where the beeping is coming from. The wish slip on {{adv|Jirachi}}'s head forms words as its third eye fully opens and glows. The statue of {{adv|Red}}, {{adv|Blue}}, {{adv|Green}}, {{adv|Yellow}}, and {{adv|Silver}} break open, turning the five Trainers back to normal. Gold congratulates Emerald for shouting his feelings and meeting his eyes with Jirachi's Eye of Truth. The five [[Pokédex holder]]s then rush to their formerly petrified teammates. ==Major events== [[File:Pokédex holders unpetrified.png|thumb|250px|The Pokédex holders unpetrified]] * {{adv|Jirachi}} grants {{adv|Emerald}}'s wish. * The [[Pokédex holder]]s are freed from their petrification. * The monster {{p|Kyogre}} floods the whole {{gdis|Battle Frontier|III}}. {{Adventuresevents}} {{endspoilers}} ===Debuts=== ====Pokémon debuts==== ==Characters== ===Humans=== * {{adv|Red}} * {{adv|Blue}} * {{adv|Green}} * {{adv|Yellow}} * {{adv|Gold}} * {{adv|Silver}} * {{adv|Crystal}} * {{adv|Ruby}} * {{adv|Sapphire}} * {{adv|Emerald}} * [[Noland]] * [[Greta]] * [[Tucker]] * [[Lucy]] * [[Spenser]] * [[Anabel]] (fantasy) * [[Brandon]] * [[Todd Snap]] (fantasy) * [[Scott]] * [[Guile Hideout]]/[[Archie]] * [[Trick Master]]/{{tt|Robot King|Chuang Yi}} (fantasy) ===Pokémon=== * {{p|Mantine}} (Tibo/{{tt|Mantaro|Chuang Yi}};
